function @down_pressed() : number
	if input_number("gamer-chair", 3) < -0.5 or input_number("gamer-chair", 1) < -0.5
		return 1
	return 0

function @clear_enemy_effects()
	$deathx.fill(12, 0)
	$deathy.fill(12, 0)
	$deathvx.fill(12, 0)
	$deathvy.fill(12, 0)
	$deathage.fill(12, -1)
	$deathsprite.fill(12, 0)
	$deathflat.fill(12, 0)
	$deathheight.fill(12, 16)

function @defeat_enemy($victim : number, $flatten : number, $direction : number)
	if $enemyalive.$victim == 0
		return
	$enemyalive.$victim = 0
	var $slot = 0
	foreach $deathage ($da, $age)
		if $age < 0
			$slot = $da
			break
	$deathx.$slot = $enemyx.$victim
	$deathy.$slot = $enemyy.$victim
	$deathvx.$slot = sign($direction, 1) * 60
	$deathvy.$slot = -185
	$deathage.$slot = 0
	$deathflat.$slot = $flatten
	$deathheight.$slot = 16
	$deathsprite.$slot = 131
	if $enemytype.$victim != 0
		$deathsprite.$slot = 132
		if $enemytype.$victim == 2 or $enemytype.$victim == 3
			$deathy.$slot = $deathy.$slot - 6
	if $enemytype.$victim == 5 or $enemyvariant.$victim == 1
		$deathsprite.$slot = 294
	if $flatten == 1
		$deathsprite.$slot = 130
		$deathvx.$slot = 0
		$deathvy.$slot = 0

function @enemy_effects_step($dt : number)
	foreach $deathage ($da, $age)
		if $age >= 0
			$deathage.$da = $age + $dt
			var $duration = 1.2
			if $deathflat.$da == 1
				$duration = 0.35
			else
				$deathx.$da = $deathx.$da + $deathvx.$da * $dt
				$deathvy.$da = $deathvy.$da + 500 * $dt
				$deathy.$da = $deathy.$da + $deathvy.$da * $dt
			if $deathage.$da >= $duration or $deathy.$da > 224
				$deathage.$da = -1

function @body_height() : number
	return 14 + $big * 16 - $duck * 10

function @spawn_enemy($sx : number, $sy : number, $st : number)
	$enemyx.append($sx)
	$enemyy.append($sy)
	$enemyvx.append(-22)
	$enemyvy.append(0)
	$enemytype.append($st)
	$enemyalive.append(1)
	$enemytimer.append(0)
	$enemygrace.append(0)
	$enemyvariant.append(0)

function @cell($tx : number, $ty : number) : number
	if $tx < 0 or $tx >= $levelwidth or $ty < 0 or $ty >= 13
		return 0
	var $ci = $ty * $levelwidth + $tx
	return $tiles.$ci

function @solid($wx : number, $wy : number) : number
	if $wx < 0
		return 1
	var $ct = @cell(floor($wx / 16), floor($wy / 16))
	if $ct > 0 and $ct != 9 and $ct != 14 and $ct != 16 and $ct != 26 and $ct != 29 and $ct != 32 and $ct != 35
		if ($ct == 15 or $ct == 25 or $ct == 33) and $wy % 16 >= 4
			return 0
		return 1
	return 0

function @enemy_clear($xx : number, $yy : number, $kind : number) : number
	var $top = 0
	var $bottom = 15
	if $kind == 1 or $kind == 4
		$top = -8
	elseif $kind == 2 or $kind == 3
		$top = -4
		$bottom = 9
	repeat 3 ($cy)
		repeat 3 ($cx)
			if @solid($xx + 1 + $cx * 6, $yy + $top + 1 + ($bottom - $top - 1) * $cy / 2) == 1
				return 0
	return 1

function @relocate_enemy($ei : number)
	if @enemy_clear($enemyx.$ei, $enemyy.$ei, $enemytype.$ei) == 1
		return
	var $sx = $enemyx.$ei
	var $sy = $enemyy.$ei
	var $fallbackx = $sx
	var $fallbacky = $sy
	var $found = 0
	var $height = 16
	if $enemytype.$ei == 2 or $enemytype.$ei == 3
		$height = 10
	for 1,10 ($radius)
		var $low = -$radius
		for $low,$radius ($dy)
			var $dx = $radius - abs($dy)
			repeat 2 ($side)
				var $xx = $sx + $dx * (1 - $side * 2) * 16
				var $yy = $sy + $dy * 16
				if $xx < 16 or $xx > $levelwidth * 16 - 28 or $yy < 0 or $yy > 176 - $height
					continue
				if $theme == 1 and $yy < 48
					continue
				if @enemy_clear($xx, $yy, $enemytype.$ei) == 1
					if $found == 0
						$fallbackx = $xx
						$fallbacky = $yy
						$found = 1
					if @solid($xx + 7, $yy + $height) == 1
						$enemyx.$ei = $xx
						$enemyy.$ei = $yy
						$enemyvy.$ei = 0
						return
	if $found == 1
		$enemyx.$ei = $fallbackx
		$enemyy.$ei = $fallbacky
		$enemyvy.$ei = 0
	else
		$enemyalive.$ei = 0

function @place_enemies()
	foreach $enemyalive ($ei, $alive)
		if $alive == 1
			@relocate_enemy($ei)

function @head_solid($wx : number, $wy : number) : number
	if @cell(floor($wx / 16), floor($wy / 16)) == 14 or @cell(floor($wx / 16), floor($wy / 16)) == 32
		return 1
	return @solid($wx, $wy)

function @safe_respawn()
	if $theme == 2
		$py = 96
		$vy = 0
		$vx = 0
		$hurt = 3
		$respawning = 0
		return
	;; Revalidate the saved feet position against the rebuilt level.
	var $targetx = $px
	var $respawnheight = @body_height()
	var $targetfeet = $py + $respawnheight
	var $found = 0
	repeat 9 ($candidate)
		var $offset = ceil($candidate / 2) * 16
		if $candidate % 2 == 0
			$offset = -$offset
		var $testx = clamp($targetx + $offset, 16, $levelwidth * 16 - 28)
		for 0,12 ($floorrow)
			var $floor = $floorrow * 16
			if abs($floor - $targetfeet) <= 48 and @solid($testx + 1, $floor) == 1 and @solid($testx + 10, $floor) == 1 and @solid($testx + 1, $floor - 1) == 0 and @solid($testx + 10, $floor - 1) == 0 and @solid($testx + 1, $floor - $respawnheight) == 0 and @solid($testx + 10, $floor - $respawnheight) == 0
				$px = $testx
				$py = $floor - $respawnheight
				$found = 1
				break
		if $found == 1
			break
	if $found == 0
		$px = 32
		$py = 162
	$cam = clamp($px - 100, 0, $levelwidth * 16 - 290)
	$vx = 0
	$vy = 0
	$hurt = 3
	$respawning = 0

function @atlas_cache($which : number, $sx : number, $sy : number, $dx : number, $dy : number, $width : number, $height : number)
	repeat 2 ($bank)
		var $offset = $bank * 10000
		var $left = max($dx, $offset)
		var $amount = min($dx + $width, $offset + 10000) - $left
		if $amount <= 0
			continue
		var $sourcex = $sx + $left - $dx
		var $destx = $left - $offset
		if $which == 0
			if $bank == 0
				screen_copy($atlas, $background, $sourcex, $sy, $destx, $dy, $amount, $height)
			else
				screen_copy($atlas, $background2, $sourcex, $sy, $destx, $dy, $amount, $height)
		else
			if $bank == 0
				screen_copy($atlas, $terrain, $sourcex, $sy, $destx, $dy, $amount, $height)
			else
				screen_copy($atlas, $terrain2, $sourcex, $sy, $destx, $dy, $amount, $height)

function @restore_cache($dx : number, $dy : number, $width : number, $height : number)
	repeat 2 ($bank)
		var $offset = $bank * 10000
		var $left = max($dx, $offset)
		var $amount = min($dx + $width, $offset + 10000) - $left
		if $amount <= 0
			continue
		var $xx = $left - $offset
		if $bank == 0
			screen_copy($background, $terrain, $xx, $dy, $xx, $dy, $amount, $height)
		else
			screen_copy($background2, $terrain2, $xx, $dy, $xx, $dy, $amount, $height)

function @background_rect($x1 : number, $y1 : number, $x2 : number, $y2 : number, $ink : number)
	repeat 2 ($bank)
		var $offset = $bank * 10000
		var $left = max($x1, $offset) - $offset
		var $right = min($x2, $offset + 10000) - $offset
		if $right <= $left
			continue
		if $bank == 0
			$background.draw_rect($left, $y1, $right, $y2, $ink, $ink)
		else
			$background2.draw_rect($left, $y1, $right, $y2, $ink, $ink)

function @draw_cache()
	var $viewx = floor($cam * $sc)
	repeat 2 ($bank)
		var $offset = $bank * 10000
		var $left = max($viewx, $offset)
		var $amount = min($viewx + 290 * $sc, $offset + 10000) - $left
		if $amount <= 0
			continue
		if $bank == 0
			screen_copy($terrain, $canvas, $left - $offset, 0, $left - $viewx, 0, $amount, 200 * $sc)
		else
			screen_copy($terrain2, $canvas, $left - $offset, 0, $left - $viewx, 0, $amount, 200 * $sc)

function @tile_sprite($ct : number) : number
	if $ct == 11
		if $theme == 1
			return 297
		elseif $theme == 3
			return 298
		return 21
	elseif $ct == 30
		return $art_coralpink
	elseif $ct == 23
		return $art_castle
	elseif $ct == 24
		return $art_coral
	elseif $ct == 25
		return $art_bridge
	elseif $ct == 26
		if $theme != 3
			return $art_water
		return $art_lava
	elseif $ct == 27
		return 2
	elseif $ct == 28
		return $art_jumpingboard
	elseif $ct == 33
		return $art_mushmid
	elseif $ct == 34
		return $art_cloud
	var $sprite = $ct
	if $ct == 4
		$sprite = 3
	elseif $ct == 11
		$sprite = 21
	elseif $ct == 12 or $ct == 13
		$sprite = 2
	elseif $ct == 15
		$sprite = 39
	elseif $ct == 16
		$sprite = 40
	if $ct >= 17 and $ct <= 22
		$sprite = 204 + $ct - 17
	if $theme == 1
		if $sprite == 1
			$sprite = 49
		elseif $sprite == 2
			$sprite = 50
		elseif $sprite == 10
			$sprite = 51
	return $sprite

function @paint_cell($tx : number, $ty : number)
	var $ct = @cell($tx, $ty)
	var $dx = $tx * 16 * $sc
	var $dy = $ty * 16 * $sc
	@restore_cache($dx, $dy, 16 * $sc, 16 * $sc)
	if $ct > 0 and $ct != 14 and $ct != 32 and $ct != 29
		var $sprite = @tile_sprite($ct)
		if $ct == 15
			if @cell($tx - 1, $ty) != 15
				$sprite = 299
			elseif @cell($tx + 1, $ty) != 15
				$sprite = 300
		if $ct == 26 and $theme != 3 and @cell($tx, $ty - 1) == 26
			$sprite = $art_waterbody
		if $ct == 33
			if @cell($tx - 1, $ty) != 33
				$sprite = $art_mushleft
			elseif @cell($tx + 1, $ty) != 33
				$sprite = $art_mushright
		if $ct == 16 and $areastyle == 1
			$sprite = $art_mushstem
		@atlas_cache(1, ($sprite % 25) * 16 * $sc, floor($sprite / 25) * 32 * $sc, $dx, $dy, 16 * $sc, 16 * $sc)

function @change_cell($tx : number, $ty : number, $newtile : number)
	if $tx >= 0 and $tx < $levelwidth and $ty >= 0 and $ty < 13
		var $ci = $ty * $levelwidth + $tx
		$tiles.$ci = $newtile
		@paint_cell($tx, $ty)

function @clear_block_effects()
	$bumpx.fill(8, 0)
	$bumpy.fill(8, 0)
	$bumpage.fill(8, -1)
	$bumpsprite.fill(8, 0)
	$popx.fill(12, 0)
	$popy.fill(12, 0)
	$popage.fill(12, -1)
	$shardx.fill(16, 0)
	$shardy.fill(16, 0)
	$shardvx.fill(16, 0)
	$shardvy.fill(16, 0)
	$shardage.fill(16, -1)
	$shardsprite.fill(16, 2)
	$poweremerge = 0

function @block_offset($tx : number, $ty : number) : number
	foreach $bumpage ($bi, $age)
		if $age >= 0 and $bumpx.$bi == $tx and $bumpy.$bi == $ty
			var $phase = ($age - 0.12) / 0.12
			return max(0, 8 * (1 - $phase * $phase))
	return 0

function @block_bumping($tx : number, $ty : number) : number
	foreach $bumpage ($bi, $age)
		if $age >= 0 and $bumpx.$bi == $tx and $bumpy.$bi == $ty
			return 1
	return 0

function @bump_block($tx : number, $ty : number)
	var $slot = 0
	foreach $bumpage ($bi, $age)
		if $age < 0
			$slot = $bi
			break
	if $bumpage.$slot >= 0
		@paint_cell($bumpx.$slot, $bumpy.$slot)
	$bumpx.$slot = $tx
	$bumpy.$slot = $ty
	$bumpage.$slot = 0
	$bumpsprite.$slot = @tile_sprite(@cell($tx, $ty))
	;; Collision keeps the tile. Only its cached image is temporarily removed.
	@restore_cache($tx * 16 * $sc, $ty * 16 * $sc, 16 * $sc, 16 * $sc)

function @pop_coin($tx : number, $ty : number)
	var $slot = 0
	foreach $popage ($ci, $age)
		if $age < 0
			$slot = $ci
			break
	$popx.$slot = $tx * 16
	$popy.$slot = $ty * 16
	$popage.$slot = 0

function @break_brick($tx : number, $ty : number)
	var $group = 0
	repeat 4 ($gi)
		var $first = $gi * 4
		if $shardage.$first < 0
			$group = $first
			break
	repeat 4 ($quad)
		var $si = $group + $quad
		$shardx.$si = $tx * 16 + ($quad % 2) * 8
		$shardy.$si = $ty * 16 + floor($quad / 2) * 8
		$shardvx.$si = -60 + ($quad % 2) * 120
		$shardvy.$si = -190 + floor($quad / 2) * 50
		$shardage.$si = 0
		$shardsprite.$si = @tile_sprite(2)

function @block_effects_step($dt : number)
	foreach $bumpage ($bi, $btime)
		if $btime >= 0
			$btime = $btime + $dt
			if $btime >= 0.24
				$bumpage.$bi = -1
				@paint_cell($bumpx.$bi, $bumpy.$bi)
			else
				$bumpage.$bi = $btime
	foreach $popage ($ci, $ctime)
		if $ctime >= 0
			$popage.$ci = $ctime + $dt
			if $popage.$ci >= 1.2
				$popage.$ci = -1
	foreach $shardage ($si, $stime)
		if $stime >= 0
			$shardage.$si = $stime + $dt
			if $shardage.$si >= 0.85
				$shardage.$si = -1

function @coin()
	$coins = $coins + 1
	$score = $score + 200
	if $coins >= 100
		$coins = $coins - 100
		$lives = $lives + 1
	@effect(2)

function @spawn_power($tx : number, $ty : number, $kind : number)
	$poweractive = 1
	$powerkind = $kind
	$poweremerge = 0.48
	$powerblockx = $tx
	$powerblocky = $ty
	$powerx = $tx * 16
	$powery = $ty * 16 - 16
	$powervx = 32
	$powervy = 0
	if $kind == 2
		$powervx = 0
	@effect(13)

function @hit_block($tx : number, $ty : number)
	if @block_bumping($tx, $ty) == 1
		return
	var $ct = @cell($tx, $ty)
	if ($ct == 2 or $ct == 3 or $ct == 4 or $ct == 11 or $ct == 12 or $ct == 13) and $poweractive == 1 and $poweremerge <= 0 and $powerkind != 2
		if $powerx + 14 > $tx * 16 and $powerx < ($tx + 1) * 16 and abs($powery + 16 - $ty * 16) < 4
			$powervy = -180
			$powervx = -$powervx
	if $ct > 0
		foreach $enemyx ($be, $bx)
			if $enemyalive.$be == 1 and $bx + 14 > $tx * 16 and $bx < ($tx + 1) * 16 and abs($enemyy.$be + 16 - $ty * 16) < 3
				@defeat_enemy($be, 0, $bx - $px)
				$score = $score + 100
	if $ct == 3
		@change_cell($tx, $ty, 11)
		@coin()
		@pop_coin($tx, $ty)
		@bump_block($tx, $ty)
	elseif $ct == 4
		@change_cell($tx, $ty, 11)
		var $kind = 1
		if $big == 1
			$kind = 2
		@spawn_power($tx, $ty, $kind)
		@bump_block($tx, $ty)
	elseif $ct == 12
		@change_cell($tx, $ty, 11)
		@spawn_power($tx, $ty, 3)
		@bump_block($tx, $ty)
	elseif $ct == 32
		@change_cell($tx, $ty, 11)
		@coin()
		@pop_coin($tx, $ty)
		@bump_block($tx, $ty)
	elseif $ct == 27
		@change_cell($tx, $ty, 11)
		$vineactive = 1
		$vinex = $tx * 16
		$viney = $ty * 16
		$vinetop = $viney
		@effect(13)
		@bump_block($tx, $ty)
	elseif $ct == 14
		@change_cell($tx, $ty, 11)
		@spawn_power($tx, $ty, 4)
		@bump_block($tx, $ty)
	elseif $ct == 13
		@coin()
		@pop_coin($tx, $ty)
		var $bi = $ty * $levelwidth + $tx
		$blockcoins.$bi = $blockcoins.$bi + 1
		if $blockcoins.$bi >= 10
			@change_cell($tx, $ty, 11)
		@bump_block($tx, $ty)
	elseif $ct == 2 and $big == 1
		@change_cell($tx, $ty, 0)
		$score = $score + 50
		@effect(10)
		@break_brick($tx, $ty)
	elseif $ct == 2
		@effect(9)
		@bump_block($tx, $ty)
	elseif $ct > 0
		@effect(9)

function @flag_bonus($nativey : number) : number
	;; Original flag thresholds use the player top in NES screen coordinates.
	if $nativey < 34
		return 5000
	elseif $nativey < 80
		return 2000
	elseif $nativey < 104
		return 800
	elseif $nativey < 144
		return 400
	return 100

function @die()
	if $mode == 3
		@silence()
		$fxkind.fill(4, 0)
		$fxclock.fill(4, 0)
		$transform = 0
		$throwtime = 0
		$mode = 5
		$sceneclock = 0
		$py = clamp($py + @body_height() - 16, 0, 180)
		$big = 0
		$fire = 0
		$duck = 0
		$hurt = 0
		$vx = 0
		$vy = -210
		$grounded = 0
		$face = 1
		$star = 0
		$jingle = 4
		$track = -1
		@effect(5)

function @damage()
	if $hurt <= 0 and $star <= 0
		if $big == 1
			$py = $py + 16 - $duck * 10
			$duck = 0
			$big = 0
			$fire = 0
			$hurt = 2
			$transform = 0.6
			$transformkind = 3
			@effect(12)
		else
			@die()

function @spawn_plant($sx : number, $base : number)
	$plantx.append($sx)
	$plantbase.append($base)
	$planty.append($base)
	$plantphase.append(0)
	$plantalive.append(1)

function @spawn_platform($xx : number, $yy : number, $range : number, $phase : number)
	$platformx.append($xx)
	$platformy.append($yy)
	$platformold.append($yy)
	$platformbase.append($yy)
	$platformrange.append($range)
	$platformphase.append($phase)
	$platformkind.append(0)
	$platformstartx.append($xx)
	$platformwidth.append(48)
	$platformpair.append(-1)

function @player_step($dt : number)
	if $theme == 2
		@swim_player($dt)
		return
	var $wantduck = $duck
	if $big == 0
		$wantduck = 0
	elseif @down_pressed() == 1 and $grounded == 1
		$wantduck = 1
	elseif @down_pressed() == 0 and $duck == 1
		if @solid($px + 1, $py - 10) == 0 and @solid($px + 10, $py - 10) == 0
			$wantduck = 0
	if $wantduck != $duck
		$py = $py + ($wantduck - $duck) * 10
		$duck = $wantduck
	$hurt = max(0, $hurt - $dt)
	$star = max(0, $star - $dt)
	$firecool = max(0, $firecool - $dt)
	$throwtime = max(0, $throwtime - $dt)
	$jumpbuffer = max(0, $jumpbuffer - $dt)
	$coyote = max(0, $coyote - $dt)
	if $grounded == 1
		$coyote = 0.09
	var $speed = 78
	if $run == 1
		$speed = 154
	var $wish = $move * $speed
	if $duck == 1 and $grounded == 1
		$wish = 0
	var $acc = 360
	if abs($move) < 0.1
		$acc = 460
	if $duck == 1 and $grounded == 1
		$acc = 95
	$vx = $vx + clamp($wish - $vx, -$acc * $dt, $acc * $dt)
	if abs($move) > 0.1
		$face = sign($move)
	
	$animclock = ($animclock + abs($vx) * $dt / 9) % 3
	if abs($vx) < 4
		$animclock = 0
	var $ph = @body_height()
	if $jumpbuffer > 0 and $coyote > 0
		$vy = -300
		if $run == 1
			$vy = -320
		$headhit = 0
		$jumpbuffer = 0
		$coyote = 0
		$grounded = 0
		@effect(1)
	if $jump == 0 and $vy < -90
		$vy = -90
	$vy = min(330, $vy + 620 * $dt)
	var $nextx = max(0, $px + $vx * $dt)
	if $vx > 0
		if @solid($nextx + 11, $py + 1) == 1 or @solid($nextx + 11, $py + $ph - 1) == 1 or @solid($nextx + 11, $py + $ph / 2) == 1
			$nextx = floor(($nextx + 11) / 16) * 16 - 12
			$vx = 0
	elseif $vx < 0
		if @solid($nextx, $py + 1) == 1 or @solid($nextx, $py + $ph - 1) == 1 or @solid($nextx, $py + $ph / 2) == 1
			$nextx = (floor($nextx / 16) + 1) * 16
			$vx = 0
	$px = max($cam, $nextx)
	var $nexty = $py + $vy * $dt
	$grounded = 0
	if $vy >= 0
		if @solid($px + 1, $nexty + $ph) == 1 or @solid($px + 10, $nexty + $ph) == 1
			$nexty = floor(($nexty + $ph) / 16) * 16 - $ph
			$vy = 0
			$grounded = 1
	elseif @head_solid($px + 1, $nexty) == 1 or @head_solid($px + 10, $nexty) == 1
		var $headrow = floor($nexty / 16)
		var $headleft = floor(($px + 1) / 16)
		var $headright = floor(($px + 10) / 16)
		if $headhit == 0
			var $headtarget = floor(($px + 6) / 16)
			if @head_solid($px + 6, $nexty) == 0
				$headtarget = $headleft
				if @head_solid($px + 1, $nexty) == 0
					$headtarget = $headright
			@hit_block($headtarget, $headrow)
			$headhit = 1
		$nexty = ($headrow + 1) * 16
		$vy = 0
	if $vy >= 0
		foreach $platformx ($pi, $plx)
			var $pltop = $platformy.$pi
			if $px + 11 > $plx and $px < $plx + $platformwidth.$pi and $py + $ph <= $platformold.$pi + 4 and $nexty + $ph >= $pltop
				$nexty = $pltop - $ph
				$vy = 0
				$grounded = 1
	$py = $nexty
	;; Collect all overlapped coins without treating them as solid tiles.
	var $r0 = max(0, floor($py / 16))
	var $r1 = min(12, floor(($py + $ph - 1) / 16))
	var $c0 = max(0, floor($px / 16))
	var $c1 = min($levelwidth - 1, floor(($px + 11) / 16))
	for $r0,$r1 ($rr)
		for $c0,$c1 ($cc)
			if @cell($cc, $rr) == 9
				@change_cell($cc, $rr, 0)
				@coin()
	if $py > 184
		if $area == 4
			@route_link($px)
		else
			@die()
	if $px > $flagx - 5 and $mode == 3
		$mode = 6
		$fxkind.0 = 0
		$fxclock.0 = 0
		@effect(17)
		$sceneclock = 0
		$finishphase = 0
		$flagy = 16
		$finishbonus = 0
		$fireworkcount = ceil($clock) % 10
		if $fireworkcount != 1 and $fireworkcount != 3 and $fireworkcount != 6
			$fireworkcount = 0
		$fireworkdone = 0
		$fireworkage = -1
		$endtick = 0
		$px = $flagx - 10
		$vx = 0
		$flagaward = @flag_bonus($py + 32)
		$flagscorey = clamp($py, 24, 152)
		$score = $score + $flagaward
		$jingle = 3
		$track = -1
	if $checkpoint < 100 and $area == 0 and $px > 78 * 16 and $grounded == 1 and $py < 180
		$checkpoint = floor($px / 16) * 16
		$checkpointy = $py + $ph - 14
	$cam = max($cam, clamp($px - 100, 0, $levelwidth * 16 - 290))
	if $world == 1 and $area == 0 and $level == 1 and @down_pressed() == 1 and $grounded == 1 and abs($px + 6 - 58 * 16) < 10 and abs($py + $ph - 112) < 3
		$warprequest = 1
	if $world == 1 and $level == 1 and $area == 1 and $move > 0.5 and $px + 12 >= 20 * 16 and $py + $ph > 144
		$warprequest = 2
	if $world == 1 and $area == 0 and $level == 2 and (($move > 0.5 and $px + 12 >= 168 * 16 and $py + $ph > 96 and $py < 128))
		$warprequest = 3
	if $world == 1 and $level == 2 and $area == 0 and $px > 174 * 16 and $py < 32
		$warprequest = 4

function @enemies_step($dt : number)
	foreach $enemyx ($ei, $ex)
		if $enemyalive.$ei == 0 or $ex < $cam - 64 or $ex > $cam + 360
			continue
		@relocate_enemy($ei)
		if $enemyalive.$ei == 0
			continue
		$ex = $enemyx.$ei
		$enemygrace.$ei = max(0, $enemygrace.$ei - $dt)
		var $et = $enemytype.$ei
		var $ey = $enemyy.$ei
		var $eh = 16
		if $et == 2 or $et == 3
			$eh = 10
		var $visualtop = 0
		if $et == 1 or $et == 4
			$visualtop = -8
		elseif $et == 2 or $et == 3
			$visualtop = -4
		var $evx = $enemyvx.$ei
		var $evy = min(280, $enemyvy.$ei + 620 * $dt)
		if $et == 2
			$evx = 0
			$enemytimer.$ei = $enemytimer.$ei + $dt
			if $enemytimer.$ei > 8 and @solid($ex + 6, $ey - 6) == 0
				$et = 1
				$enemytype.$ei = 1
				if $enemyvariant.$ei == 1
					$enemytype.$ei = 5
				$ey = $ey - 6
				$eh = 16
				$evx = -22
		var $enx = $ex + $evx * $dt
		var $edge = $enx + 13
		if $evx < 0
			$edge = $enx
		if @solid($edge, $ey + $visualtop + 1) == 1 or @solid($edge, $ey + 4) == 1 or @solid($edge, $ey + $eh - 2) == 1
			$evx = -$evx
			$enx = $ex
		if $et == 1 and $enemyvariant.$ei == 2 and @solid($ex + 7, $ey + $eh) == 1 and @solid($edge, $ey + $eh + 2) == 0
			$evx = -$evx
			$enx = $ex
		var $eny = $ey + $evy * $dt
		if $evy >= 0 and (@solid($enx + 2, $eny + $eh) == 1 or @solid($enx + 11, $eny + $eh) == 1)
			$eny = floor(($eny + $eh) / 16) * 16 - $eh
			$evy = 0
			if $et == 4
				$evy = -185
		elseif $evy < 0 and (@solid($enx + 2, $eny + $visualtop) == 1 or @solid($enx + 11, $eny + $visualtop) == 1)
			$eny = (floor(($eny + $visualtop) / 16) + 1) * 16 - $visualtop
			$evy = 0
		$enemyx.$ei = $enx
		$enemyy.$ei = $eny
		$enemyvx.$ei = $evx
		$enemyvy.$ei = $evy
		if $eny > 224
			$enemyalive.$ei = 0
		if $et == 3
			foreach $enemyx ($other, $ox)
				if $other != $ei and $enemyalive.$other == 1 and abs($ox - $enx) < 14 and abs($enemyy.$other - $eny) < 16
					@defeat_enemy($other, 0, $evx)
					$enemytimer.$ei = min(7, $enemytimer.$ei + 1)
					$score = $score + 100 * pow(2, $enemytimer.$ei)
					@effect(11)
		var $ph = @body_height()
		if $mode == 3 and $enemyalive.$ei == 1 and $px + 11 > $enx and $px < $enx + 14 and $py + $ph > $eny and $py < $eny + $eh
			if $star > 0
				@defeat_enemy($ei, 0, $vx)
				$starcombo = min(7, $starcombo + 1)
				$score = $score + 100 * pow(2, $starcombo)
				@effect(11)
			elseif $vy > 0 and $py + $ph - $vy * $dt <= $eny + 6
				$vy = -145
				$headhit = 0
				$py = $eny - $ph
				$score = $score + 100
				@effect(4)
				if $et == 0
					@defeat_enemy($ei, 1, 0)
				elseif $et == 4
					$enemytype.$ei = 1
				elseif $et == 2
					$enemytype.$ei = 3
					$enemyvx.$ei = sign($enx + 7 - ($px + 6), $face) * 165
					$enemygrace.$ei = 0.2
					$enemytimer.$ei = 0
				else
					if $et == 1 or $et == 5
						$enemyy.$ei = $eny + 6
					$enemytype.$ei = 2
					$enemyvx.$ei = 0
					$enemytimer.$ei = 0
					$enemygrace.$ei = 0.18
			elseif $et == 2 and $enemygrace.$ei <= 0
				$enemytype.$ei = 3
				$enemyvx.$ei = sign($enx + 7 - ($px + 6), $face) * 165
				$enemygrace.$ei = 0.2
				$enemytimer.$ei = 0
				@effect(11)
			elseif $enemygrace.$ei <= 0
				@damage()

function @power_step($dt : number)
	if $poweractive == 0
		return
	if $poweremerge > 0
		$poweremerge = max(0, $poweremerge - $dt)
		return
	if $powerkind != 2
		$powervy = min(280, $powervy + 620 * $dt)
		$powerx = $powerx + $powervx * $dt
		var $edge = $powerx + 14
		if $powervx < 0
			$edge = $powerx
		if @solid($edge, $powery + 3) == 1 or @solid($edge, $powery + 13) == 1
			$powervx = -$powervx
			$powerx = $powerx + $powervx * $dt * 2
		$powery = $powery + $powervy * $dt
		if $powervy < 0 and (@solid($powerx + 2, $powery) == 1 or @solid($powerx + 12, $powery) == 1)
			$powery = (floor($powery / 16) + 1) * 16
			$powervy = 0
		if $powervy >= 0 and (@solid($powerx + 2, $powery + 16) == 1 or @solid($powerx + 12, $powery + 16) == 1)
			$powery = floor(($powery + 16) / 16) * 16 - 16
			$powervy = 0
			if $powerkind == 3
				$powervy = -180
	if $powery > 224
		$poweractive = 0
	if $px + 12 > $powerx and $px < $powerx + 16 and $py + @body_height() > $powery and $py < $powery + 16
		if $powerkind == 3
			$star = 12
			$starcombo = 0
			$track = -1
		elseif $powerkind == 4
			$lives = $lives + 1
		elseif $big == 0
			if @solid($px + 1, $py - 16) == 0 and @solid($px + 10, $py - 16) == 0
				$py = $py - 16
				$duck = 0
				$big = 1
				$transform = 0.8
				$transformkind = 1
				$hurt = max($hurt, 0.6)
				if $powerkind == 2
					$fire = 1
		elseif $powerkind == 2
			if $fire == 0
				$transform = 0.6
				$transformkind = 2
				$hurt = max($hurt, 0.6)
			$fire = 1
		$score = $score + 1000
		$poweractive = 0
		if $powerkind == 4
			@effect(14)
		else
			@effect(3)

function @plants_step($dt : number)
	foreach $plantx ($qi, $qx)
		if $plantalive.$qi == 0 or $qx < $cam - 32 or $qx > $cam + 320
			continue
		var $base = $plantbase.$qi
		var $phase = $plantphase.$qi
		;; Stay hidden when Mario is standing on or immediately beside the pipe.
		if $phase > 0 or abs($px + 6 - ($qx + 8)) > 27
			$phase = ($phase + $dt) % 4
		$plantphase.$qi = $phase
		var $rise = 0
		if $phase < 0.8
			$rise = $phase / 0.8
		elseif $phase < 2
			$rise = 1
		elseif $phase < 2.8
			$rise = 1 - ($phase - 2) / 0.8
		$planty.$qi = $base - 24 * $rise
		if $rise > 0.3 and $px + 11 > $qx and $px < $qx + 16 and $py + @body_height() > $planty.$qi and $py < $base
			if $star > 0
				$plantalive.$qi = 0
				$score = $score + 200
			else
				@damage()

function @platforms_step($dt : number)
	foreach $platformx ($pi, $plx)
		var $oldtop = $platformy.$pi
		$platformold.$pi = $oldtop
		var $riding = 0
		if $grounded == 1 and abs($py + @body_height() - $oldtop) < 2 and $px + 11 > $plx and $px < $plx + $platformwidth.$pi
			$riding = 1
		$platformphase.$pi = $platformphase.$pi + $dt
		var $kind = $platformkind.$pi
		var $newx = $plx
		var $top = $oldtop
		if $kind == 0
			var $phase = ($platformphase.$pi % 6) / 3
			if $phase > 1
				$phase = 2 - $phase
			$top = $platformbase.$pi + $platformrange.$pi * $phase
		elseif $kind == 36
			if $riding == 1
				$top = min(190, $oldtop + 28 * $dt)
				var $paired = $platformpair.$pi
				if $paired >= 0
					$platformy.$paired = $platformy.$paired - $top + $oldtop
		elseif $kind == 37
			$top = $platformbase.$pi + 64 - cos($platformphase.$pi * 1.1) * 64
		elseif $kind == 38 or $kind == 43
			$top = $oldtop - 32 * $dt
			if $top < -24
				$top = 208
		elseif $kind == 39 or $kind == 44
			$top = $oldtop + 32 * $dt
			if $top > 208
				$top = -24
		elseif $kind == 40
			$newx = $platformstartx.$pi + sin($platformphase.$pi * 0.9) * 56
		elseif $kind == 41
			if $riding == 1 or $oldtop > $platformbase.$pi
				$top = $oldtop + 48 * $dt
		elseif $kind == 42
			if $riding == 1 or $plx > $platformstartx.$pi
				$newx = $plx + 64 * $dt
		$platformx.$pi = $newx
		$platformy.$pi = $top
		if $riding == 1 and abs($top - $oldtop) < 24
			$py = $py + $top - $oldtop
			$px = $px + $newx - $plx

function @shoot()
	if $fire == 0 or $firecool > 0 or $mode != 3 or $transform > 0 or $duck == 1
		return
	repeat 2 ($fi)
		if $firelife.$fi <= 0
			$firex.$fi = $px + 6 + $face * 8
			$firey.$fi = $py + 10
			$firevx.$fi = $face * 175
			$firevy.$fi = 30
			$firelife.$fi = 2.4
			$firecool = 0.17
			$throwtime = 0.2
			@effect(7)
			return

function @fireballs_step($dt : number)
	repeat 2 ($fi)
		if $firelife.$fi <= 0
			continue
		$firelife.$fi = max(0, $firelife.$fi - $dt)
		var $fx = $firex.$fi + $firevx.$fi * $dt
		var $fvy = min(220, $firevy.$fi + 500 * $dt)
		var $fy = $firey.$fi + $fvy * $dt
		if @solid($fx + 3, $fy) == 1
			$firelife.$fi = 0
		elseif @solid($fx + 3, $fy + 6) == 1 and $fvy > 0
			$fy = floor(($fy + 6) / 16) * 16 - 7
			$fvy = -130
		$firex.$fi = $fx
		$firey.$fi = $fy
		$firevy.$fi = $fvy
		foreach $enemyx ($ei, $ex)
			if $firelife.$fi > 0 and $enemyalive.$ei == 1 and $enemyvariant.$ei != 1 and abs($fx - ($ex + 7)) < 12 and abs($fy - ($enemyy.$ei + 8)) < 14
				@defeat_enemy($ei, 0, $firevx.$fi)
				$firelife.$fi = 0
				$score = $score + 200
				@effect(11)
		foreach $plantx ($qi, $qx)
			if $firelife.$fi > 0 and $plantalive.$qi == 1 and $planty.$qi < $plantbase.$qi - 5 and abs($fx - ($qx + 8)) < 12 and abs($fy - ($planty.$qi + 8)) < 13
				$plantalive.$qi = 0
				$firelife.$fi = 0
				$score = $score + 200

init

update
	var $dt = clamp(delta_time, 0, 0.12)
	var $token = input_text("gamer-chair", 0)
	$seated = 0
	if $token != "" and $token != "0"
		$seated = 1
	output_number("light", 0, 1 - $seated)
	$jump = 0
	$move = 0
	$run = 0
	$firekey = 0
	$pausekey = 0
	$restartkey = 0
	$mutekey = 0
	var $selectkey = 0
	if $seated == 1
		$move = clamp(input_number("gamer-chair", 2), -1, 1)
		if input_number("gamer-chair", 3) > 0.5 or input_number("gamer-chair", 8) > 0.5
			$jump = 1
		if input_number("gamer-chair", 9) > 0.5 or input_number("gamer-chair", 1) > 0.5
			$run = 1
		if input_number("gamer-chair", 5) > 0.5
			$firekey = 1
		$pausekey = input_number("gamer-chair", 10)
		$restartkey = input_number("gamer-chair", 11)
		$mutekey = input_number("gamer-chair", 12)
		if @down_pressed() == 1 or input_number("gamer-chair", 13) > 0.5
			$selectkey = 1
	$jumpedge = 0
	if $jump == 1 and $jumplast == 0
		$jumpedge = 1
	if $mutekey > 0.5 and $mutelast <= 0.5
		$muted = 1 - $muted
		$musicgate = 0
		@silence()
	if $restartkey > 0.5 and $restartlast <= 0.5 and $assetsready == 1
		@new_game()
	if $demo == 1 and ($jumpedge == 1 or $run == 1 or $firekey == 1)
		@new_game()
	if $pausekey > 0.5 and $pauselast <= 0.5 and $demo == 0
		if $mode == 3
			$mode = 4
		elseif $mode == 4
			$mode = 3
		elseif $mode == 1 or $mode == 7 or $mode == 8
			$mode = 0
	if $assetsready == 0
		if $assetstep < $art.size
			@cache_sprite($assetstep)
			$assetstep = $assetstep + 1
		elseif $logorow < $logo.size
			@cache_logo_row()
		else
			@title_footer()
			$assetsready = 1
	elseif $mode == 0
		if $jumpedge == 1
			$mode = 1
			$titleclock = 0
	elseif $mode == 1
		$titleclock = $titleclock + $dt
		if $selectkey == 1 and $selectlast == 0
			$menuplayers = 3 - $menuplayers
			$titleclock = 0
		if $jumpedge == 1
			@new_game()
		elseif $titleclock > 8
			@new_game()
			$demo = 1
			$track = -1
			$musicgate = 0
			$democlock = 0
			$demohold = 0
	elseif $mode == 7 or $mode == 8
		if $jumpedge == 1
			$mode = 1
			$titleclock = 0
	elseif $mode == 2
		@build_columns()
	elseif $mode == 3
		if $seated == 0 and $demo == 0
			$mode = 4
		else
			$gameclock = $gameclock + $dt
			$transform = max(0, $transform - $dt)
			if $demo == 1
				$democlock = $democlock + $dt
				$move = 1
				$run = 0
				$demohold = max(0, $demohold - $dt)
				var $feet = $py + @body_height()
				var $danger = @solid($px + 26, $feet - 4)
				if @solid($px + 28, $feet + 2) == 0 and $grounded == 1
					$danger = 1
				foreach $enemyx ($di, $dx)
					if $enemyalive.$di == 1 and $dx > $px and $dx < $px + 34
						$danger = 1
				if $grounded == 1 and ($danger == 1 or floor($democlock * 2) % 7 == 0)
					$jumpbuffer = 0.12
					$demohold = 0.5
				$jump = 0
				if $demohold > 0
					$jump = 1
				if $democlock > 25
					$demo = 0
					$mode = 1
					$titleclock = 0
			elseif $jumpedge == 1
				$jumpbuffer = 0.12
			$hurrytime = max(0, $hurrytime - $dt)
			if $transform <= 0
				$clock = max(0, $clock - $dt * 2.5)
			if $clock > 0 and $clock <= 100 and $hurry == 0
				$hurry = 1
				$hurrytime = 2.8
			if $clock <= 0
				@die()
			var $steps = max(1, ceil($dt / 0.016))
			var $step = $dt / $steps
			repeat $steps ($sub)
				if $mode != 3 or $transform > 0
					break
				@platforms_step($step)
				@player_step($step)
				if $mode == 3
					if $sub == 0 and $firekey == 1 and $firelast == 0
						@shoot()
					@enemies_step($step)
					@power_step($step)
					@plants_step($step)
					@fireballs_step($step)
					@advanced_step($step)
					@projectiles_step($step)
					@firebars_step($step)
					@boss_step($step)
					@world_features($step)
			if $warprequest > 0 and $mode == 3
				@warp()
	elseif $mode == 5
		$sceneclock = $sceneclock + $dt
		;; Hold the front-facing pose, then hop and fall through the level.
		if $sceneclock > 0.4
			var $deathdt = min($dt, $sceneclock - 0.4)
			$vy = $vy + 500 * $deathdt
			$py = $py + $vy * $deathdt
		if $sceneclock > 3.1
			$lives = $lives - 1
			@resume_life()
	elseif $mode == 6
		@finish_step($dt)
	if $score > $best and $demo == 0
		$best = $score
	if $mode == 3 or $mode == 5 or $mode == 6
		@block_effects_step($dt)
		@enemy_effects_step($dt)
	@render()
	@sound($dt)
	$jumplast = $jump
	$firelast = $firekey
	$pauselast = $pausekey
	$restartlast = $restartkey
	$mutelast = $mutekey
	$selectlast = $selectkey

shutdown
	@silence()
	output_number("light", 0, 1)

function @terrain_art($first : number, $cols : number, $countrows : number, $xx : number, $yy : number)
	repeat $countrows ($arow)
		repeat $cols ($acol)
			var $sid = $first + $arow * $cols + $acol
			@atlas_cache(0, ($sid % 25) * 16 * $sc, floor($sid / 25) * 32 * $sc, ($xx + $acol * 16) * $sc, ($yy + $arow * 32) * $sc, 16 * $sc, 32 * $sc)

function @cache_scenery()
	$background.blank($sky)
	$background2.blank($sky)
	if $theme == 0 and $area != 1
		var $clouds = floor($levelwidth / 18)
		repeat $clouds ($ci)
			@terrain_art(150, 2, 1, (8 + $ci * 18) * 16, 16)
		if ($world == 1 and $level == 1) or $area == 2 or $world > 1
			var $sets = ceil($levelwidth / 48)
			repeat $sets ($si)
				var $sx = $si * 48 * 16
				@terrain_art(136, 5, 2, $sx, 136)
				@terrain_art(146, 4, 1, $sx + 184, 152)
				@terrain_art(136, 5, 2, $sx + 256, 136)
				@terrain_art(146, 4, 1, $sx + 376, 152)
	foreach $featurekind ($castle, $ck)
		if $ck == 12 and $featurex.$castle < $flagx
			@terrain_art(152, 5, 3, $featurex.$castle, 96)
	if $theme == 2
		repeat $levelwidth ($watercol)
			@terrain_art($art_water, 1, 1, $watercol * 16, -8)
	if $flagx < $levelwidth * 16
		@background_rect(($flagx - 1) * $sc, 16 * $sc, $flagx * $sc, 160 * $sc, color(128, 208, 16))
		@atlas_cache(0, (210 % 25) * 16 * $sc, floor(210 / 25) * 32 * $sc, ($flagx - 8) * $sc, 0, 16 * $sc, 16 * $sc)
		@terrain_art(152, 5, 3, $flagx + 56, 96)

	@restore_cache(0, 0, $levelwidth * 16 * $sc, 200 * $sc)

function @build_columns()
	if $decodeindex < $encodedrows.size
		@decode_row()
		return
	if $loadcol == 0
		@cache_scenery()
	repeat 3 ($build)
		if $loadcol >= $levelwidth
			break
		repeat 13 ($row)
			if $restorecache == 0
				var $line = $rows.$row
				var $ch = substring($line, $loadcol, 1)
				var $tv = find("0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ", $ch)
				var $ti = $row * $levelwidth + $loadcol
				$tiles.$ti = max(0, $tv)
				if $loadcol + 1 < $levelwidth
					var $ahead = $ti + 1
					$tiles.$ahead = max(0, find("0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ", substring($line, $loadcol + 1, 1)))
			if @cell($loadcol, $row) > 0
				@paint_cell($loadcol, $row)
		$loadcol = $loadcol + 1
	if $loadcol >= $levelwidth
		if $demo == 1
			$track = -1
			$musicgate = 0
		@place_enemies()
		if $entryneeded >= 0
			@entry_position($entryneeded)
			$cam = clamp($px - 100, 0, $levelwidth * 16 - 290)
			$entryneeded = -1
		if $spawnneeded == 1
			@safe_respawn()
			$hurt = 0
			$spawnneeded = 0
		if $respawning == 1
			@safe_respawn()
		$mode = 3
		$jumplast = $jump
		$jumpbuffer = 0

function @resume_life()
	if $demo == 1
		$demo = 0
		$mode = 1
		$titleclock = 0
		return
	$playerworld.$player = $world
	$playerlevel.$player = $level
	$playerscore.$player = $score
	$playercoins.$player = $coins
	$playerlives.$player = $lives
	$playercheck.$player = $checkpoint
	$playerchecky.$player = $checkpointy
	if $players == 2
		var $other = 1 - $player
		if $playerlives.$other > 0
			$player = $other
	$world = $playerworld.$player
	$level = $playerlevel.$player
	$score = $playerscore.$player
	$coins = $playercoins.$player
	$lives = $playerlives.$player
	if $lives <= 0
		$mode = 7
		$track = -1
		return
	var $restartx = $playercheck.$player
	$big = 0
	$fire = 0
	$star = 0
	@begin_level()
	$px = $restartx
	$py = $playerchecky.$player
	$checkpointy = $py
	$respawning = 1
	$spawnx = $restartx
	$checkpoint = $restartx
	$cam = clamp($px - 100, 0, $levelwidth * 16 - 290)

function @advance_stage()
	$level = $level + 1
	if $level > 4
		$world = $world + 1
		$level = 1
	if $world > 4
		$mode = 8
		$track = -1
		return
	$playerworld.$player = $world
	$playerlevel.$player = $level
	$playercheck.$player = 32
	$playerchecky.$player = 162
	@begin_level()

function @fireworks_step($dt : number)
	if $fireworkdone >= $fireworkcount
		return
	if $fireworkage < 0
		$fireworkage = 0
		$fireworkx = $flagx + 32 + (($fireworkdone * 3) % 5) * 16
		$fireworky = 40 + ($fireworkdone % 3) * 24
	$fireworkage = $fireworkage + $dt
	if $fireworkage >= 0.4 and $fireworkage - $dt < 0.4
		$score = $score + 500
		@effect(16)
	if $fireworkage >= 0.533333
		$fireworkdone = $fireworkdone + 1

function @native_enemy($xx : number, $row : number, $kind : number)
	var $yy = $row * 16 - 32

		@spawn_enemy($xx, $yy, 0)
	elseif $kind == 0 or $kind == 3
		@spawn_enemy($xx, $yy, 1)
		var $nativeindex = $enemyvariant.size - 1

		$barx.append($xx + 4)

		$barphase.append(0)
		$barspeed.append(1.2 * (1 - ($kind % 2) * 2))

		if $kind == 31

	elseif $kind >= 36 and $kind <= 44
		@spawn_platform($xx, max(24, $yy), 64, 0)
		var $liftindex = $platformkind.size - 1
		$platformkind.$liftindex = $kind
		if $kind == 36
			foreach $platformkind ($partner, $otherkind)
				if $partner < $liftindex and $otherkind == 36 and $platformpair.$partner < 0

		$bossy = $yy

		var $group = $kind - 55
		var $groupy = 144
		if floor($group / 2) % 2 == 1
			$groupy = 80
		var $groupsize = 2 + $group % 2
		repeat $groupsize ($member)
			var $grouptype = 0

function @decode_row()
	var $encoded = $encodedrows.$decodeindex
	var $decoded = ""
	var $cursor = 0
	while $cursor < size($encoded)
		var $tile = substring($encoded, $cursor, 1)
		var $count = find("0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ", substring($encoded, $cursor + 1, 1))
		repeat $count ($part)
			$decoded = text("{}{}", $decoded, $tile)
		$cursor = $cursor + 2
	$rows.$decodeindex = $decoded
	$decodeindex = $decodeindex + 1

function @swim_player($dt : number)
	if $mode != 3
		return
	$hurt = max(0, $hurt - $dt)
	$star = max(0, $star - $dt)
	$firecool = max(0, $firecool - $dt)
	$throwtime = max(0, $throwtime - $dt)
	$swimcool = max(0, $swimcool - $dt)
	$jumpbuffer = max(0, $jumpbuffer - $dt)
	$duck = 0
	var $swimheight = @body_height()
	var $swimwant = $move * 76
	if $run == 1
		$swimwant = $move * 96
	$vx = $vx + clamp($swimwant - $vx, -150 * $dt, 150 * $dt)
	if abs($move) > 0.1
		$face = sign($move)
	$vy = min(48, $vy + 90 * $dt)
	if ($jump == 1 or $jumpbuffer > 0) and $swimcool <= 0
		$vy = -72
		$swimcool = 0.25
		$jumpbuffer = 0
		$headhit = 0
	foreach $featurekind ($current, $fk)
		if $fk == 4 and $px + 6 > $featurex.$current - 16 and $px + 6 < $featurex.$current + $featurevalue.$current + 16 and $py > 72
			var $center = $featurex.$current + $featurevalue.$current / 2
			$vx = $vx + clamp($center - $px - 6, -24, 24) * $dt
			$vy = $vy + 70 * $dt
	var $swimx = max($cam, $px + $vx * $dt)
	var $edge = $swimx
	if $vx > 0
		$edge = $swimx + 11
	if @solid($edge, $py + 1) == 1 or @solid($edge, $py + $swimheight - 1) == 1 or @solid($edge, $py + $swimheight / 2) == 1
		$swimx = $px
		$vx = 0
	$px = $swimx
	var $swimy = max(0, $py + $vy * $dt)
	$grounded = 0
	if $vy >= 0 and (@solid($px + 1, $swimy + $swimheight) == 1 or @solid($px + 10, $swimy + $swimheight) == 1)
		$swimy = floor(($swimy + $swimheight) / 16) * 16 - $swimheight
		$vy = 0
		$grounded = 1
	elseif $vy < 0 and (@head_solid($px + 1, $swimy) == 1 or @head_solid($px + 10, $swimy) == 1)
		var $swimrow = floor($swimy / 16)
		if $headhit == 0
			var $swimcol = floor(($px + 6) / 16)
			@hit_block($swimcol, $swimrow)
			$headhit = 1
		$swimy = ($swimrow + 1) * 16
		$vy = 0
	$py = $swimy
	$animclock = ($animclock + $dt * 6) % 3
	var $swimr0 = max(0, floor($py / 16))
	var $swimr1 = min(12, floor(($py + $swimheight - 1) / 16))
	var $swimc0 = max(0, floor($px / 16))
	var $swimc1 = min($levelwidth - 1, floor(($px + 11) / 16))
	for $swimr0,$swimr1 ($sr)
		for $swimc0,$swimc1 ($scell)
			if @cell($scell, $sr) == 9
				@change_cell($scell, $sr, 0)
				@coin()
	if $py > 184
		@die()
	$cam = max($cam, clamp($px - 100, 0, $levelwidth * 16 - 290))

function @advanced_sprite($kind : number, $direction : number, $frame : number) : number
	var $sprite = $art_spiny
	if $kind == 5
		$sprite = $art_thehammerbrothers
	elseif $kind == 7
		$sprite = $art_bloober
	elseif $kind == 10
		$sprite = $art_cheepcheepgrey
	elseif $kind == 11 or $kind == 20
		$sprite = $art_cheepcheepred
	elseif $kind == 12
		$sprite = $art_podoboo
	elseif $kind == 15 or $kind == 16
		$sprite = 42
		if $frame == 1
			$sprite = 135
		if $direction < 0
			$sprite = 202 + $frame
		if $kind == 15
			$sprite = $art_redwing + $frame
			if $direction < 0
				$sprite = $sprite + 2
		return $sprite
	elseif $kind == 17

	if $mode != 3

		var $avx = $advvx.$ai
		var $avy = $advvy.$ai

				$avy = -55
				$avx = sign($px - $ax) * 30
			else
				$avy = 24

			$ay = clamp($ay + $avy * $dt, 20, 154)
			$ax = $ax + $avx * $dt
		elseif $ak == 10 or $ak == 11
			$avx = -24

				$avx = -38

		elseif $ak == 12

				$ay = 204

		elseif $ak == 15 or $ak == 16

				var $flightspan = 64
				if $advbase.$ai >= 96
					$flightspan = -64
				$ay = $advbase.$ai + $flightspan * (1 - cos($age * 1.6)) / 2
				$avy = $flightspan * 0.8 * sin($age * 1.6)
			else

			$ay = 16 + sin($age * 2) * 5
			$avx = $px - $ax
			if $age > 2.8
				@hostile_shot(1, $ax + 8, $ay + 16, sign($px - $ax) * 28, -80)
				$advtime.$ai = 0
		else
			$avy = min(260, $avy + 520 * $dt)
			if $ak == 5
				$avx = sin($age * 1.8) * 18
				if $advstate.$ai == 0 and $age > 1.1
					@hostile_shot(0, $ax + 6, $ay, sign($px - $ax) * 70, -185)
					$advstate.$ai = 1
				if $age > 1.65

					$advstate.$ai = 0
					if @solid($ax + 7, $ay + $ah + 1) == 1
						$avy = -215
			$ax = $ax + $avx * $dt
			var $aedge = $ax
			if $avx > 0

			$ay = $ay + $avy * $dt

		$advvy.$ai = $avy

		if $advalive.$ai == 1 and $px + 11 > $ax and $px < $ax + 14 and $py + @body_height() > $ay and $py < $ay + $ah
			if $star > 0 and $ak != 12
				@advanced_kill($ai)

				$vy = -145

				@effect(4)

function @castle_end_step($dt : number)
	$gameclock = $gameclock + $dt
	$sceneclock = $sceneclock + $dt
	$bridgefall = max(0, $bridgefall) + $dt
	var $removed = min(13, floor($bridgefall / 0.09))
	repeat $removed ($tile)
		var $column = floor($bridgeright / 16) - 1 - $tile
		if @cell($column, 8) != 0
			@change_cell($column, 8, 0)
	if $bridgefall > 0.3 and $bossdead == 0
		$bossdead = 1
		$bossvy = 40
	if $bossdead == 1
		$bossvy = $bossvy + 400 * $dt
		$bossy = $bossy + $bossvy * $dt
	if $sceneclock < 1.8
		$vx = 0
		$finishphase = 0
	else
		$finishphase = 1
		$face = 1
		$vx = 38
		$move = 1
		$grounded = 0

function @world_features($dt : number)

		return
	$zonemessage = max(0, $zonemessage - $dt)

		$warprequest = 3
		return
	foreach $featurekind ($feature, $fk)
		var $fx = $featurex.$feature

				var $destination = 4 - floor(($fx - 128) / 64)
				$pendingarea = -1
				$pendingentry = $destination
				$warprequest = 101
			elseif $zone == 2 or $zone == 5
				$zonemessage = 6
			else
				@route_link($fx)
		elseif $fk == 1 and $move > 0.5 and $px + 12 >= $fx and $px < $fx + 16 and $py + @body_height() > $fy and $py < $fy + 32
			@route_link($fx)
			if $area == 0 and ($theme == 1 or $theme == 2) and $pendingarea >= 32 and $pendingarea < 64
				$warprequest = 3
		elseif $fk == 2 and $vy >= 0 and $px + 11 > $fx and $px < $fx + 16 and abs($py + @body_height() - $fy) < 5
			$vy = -480
			$grounded = 0
			$headhit = 0
			@effect(1)
		elseif $fk == 6 and $bridgefall < 0 and $px + 11 > $fx - 8 and $px < $fx + 10 and $py < 128 and $py + @body_height() > 92
			$px = $axe + 8
			$py = min($py, 112 - @body_height())
			$vy = 0
			$bridgefall = 0
			$mode = 6
			$sceneclock = 0
			$finishphase = 0
			$finishhold = 0
			$finishbonus = 0
			$vx = 0
			$track = -1
		elseif $fk == 7 and $world == 4 and $level == 4 and $featurestate.$feature == 0 and $px >= $fx - 32
			var $targetfeet = 64
			if $fx > 1600
				$targetfeet = 176
			if $grounded == 1 and abs($py + @body_height() - $targetfeet) < 3
				$featurestate.$feature = 1
			else
				$pendingentry = max(32, $px - 1024)
				$warprequest = 200
				return
		elseif ($fk == 8 or $fk == 10 or $fk == 11) and $featurestate.$feature == 0 and $px > $fx - 120
			$featurestate.$feature = 1
			$frenzykind = 0
			if $fk == 8
				$frenzykind = 1
			elseif $fk == 10
				$frenzykind = 3
				if $theme == 2
					$frenzykind = 2
		elseif $fk == 9 and $fx > $cam - 32 and $fx < $cam + 330
			$featurestate.$feature = $featurestate.$feature + $dt
			if $featurestate.$feature > 3 and abs($px - $fx) > 32
				@hostile_shot(3, $fx, $fy, sign($px - $fx) * 100, 0)
				$featurestate.$feature = 0
	if $vineactive == 1
		$vinetop = max(-16, $vinetop - 100 * $dt)
		if abs($px + 6 - $vinex - 8) < 11 and $py + @body_height() > $vinetop and $py < $viney
			var $climb = input_number("gamer-chair", 1)
			if abs($climb) > 0.5
				$py = $py - $climb * 65 * $dt
				$vy = 0
				$vx = 0
				$grounded = 0
				if $py < 0
					@route_link($vinex)
	if $area == 0 and $world == 4 and $level == 2 and $px > 3056 and $py < 32
		$zone = 5
		$plantalive.fill($plantalive.size, 0)
	$frenzytimer = $frenzytimer + $dt
	if $frenzykind > 0 and $frenzytimer > 1.1
		$frenzytimer = 0
		if $frenzykind == 1
			@hostile_shot(4, $cam + 225, 208, -65, -240)
		elseif $frenzykind == 2
			@spawn_advanced(11, $cam + 310, 32 + floor($gameclock * 37) % 110)
		else
			@hostile_shot(3, $cam + 310, clamp($py + 8, 24, 155), -110, 0)
	foreach $advkind ($victim, $vk)
		if $advalive.$victim == 0 or $vk == 12
			continue
		foreach $enemytype ($shell, $sk)
			if $sk == 3 and $enemyalive.$shell == 1 and abs($enemyx.$shell - $advx.$victim) < 14 and abs($enemyy.$shell - $advy.$victim) < 24
				@advanced_kill($victim)
		foreach $bumpage ($bumped, $bt)
			if $bt >= 0 and $bt < 0.15 and $advx.$victim + 14 > $bumpx.$bumped * 16 and $advx.$victim < ($bumpx.$bumped + 1) * 16 and abs($advy.$victim + 24 - $bumpy.$bumped * 16) < 4
				@advanced_kill($victim)
